name: pi-ui
description: pi extension: unified TUI — editor stack (selection, history, :q), style prompt, chrome wraps (no-header, status footer), starship widget. Replaces pi-open-tui, pi-atuin, supi-prompt-suggestions, pi-chrome, pi-starship.

scripts.test: for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --experimental-strip-types $f || exit 1; done
